notes.title: Final Update (QoL, subtitles and more)
notes.content:
[h3]Dear [i]End Transmission?[/i] Players, our long-awaited final update is finally here![/h3]

This update brings you the Official Soundtrack! You can now play and download all the cassette music from your Steam library. These tracks were made by our awesome composer, Morten Heide, post-launch. 'Morning' and 'Evening' tracks are also included.

In this update there are also a few quality-of-life changes, improved tutorials and bug fixes.
Finally, we now support [b]Danish[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] subtitles.

We would like to thank you, the Players, for giving our game a spin and letting us tell the story of Lenna.

This game has been quite the journey. It has made us meet new amazing people, learn a ton of skills, and tell a story that we're all very proud of.

Remember we have a Discord server where we can chill and play together! Here is the link: https://discord.gg/pahCsQj9H6

Remember to cherish every moment, live out your dreams, and share the love with those close to you.

With love,
Team Tall Trees

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Further decreased the difficulty of "Old Man's Treasure"
[*] Corrected several mistakes in the subtitles
[/list]

[h2]A look into the future[/h2]

[b]Expect the full soundtrack of [i]End Transmission?[/i] to be available before the end of the month![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
Once again, thank you to everyone who has been playing the game and leaving reviews. It means a lot to all of us when you share your experiences. 
Here are some more changes we've made to better the experience.

[list]
[*] Added a statue to the town for easier quest progression in the Treasure Map quest "Old Man's Treasure'
[*] Added a new cursor when using the dials to highlight the direction to pull it
[*] Items can now be inspected at the radio
[*] Small UX tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Many more resolution options (not just 16:9) and also above 2K options
[*] Bygone Comrade and Dejavu Weddings quests are easier to complete
[*] You can't get stuck in the binoculars on the last day anymore
[*] The back button in main menu settings is now easier to click
[*] Some had issues with completing the "Fan mail" achievement which should be fixed
[*] You don't swing around after using ladder
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you to everyone who has been playing the game.[/h2]

If you have issues, please message us at [u]teamtalltrees+support@gmail.com[/u] or post in the discussions. We know some people are still experiencing bugs, and we would very much like to fix them!

[h3]For now, the following issues have been fixed:[/h3]

[list]
[*] VSync support added
[*] Can now limit FPS
[*] Hard-to-read subtitles made easier to read
[*] New "Controls" graphic in options
[*] The sculpture from the "Fleeting Knowledge" quest now rotates around its center
[*] Small audio changes to ambience
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where if Tuvi was busy just when the day ended, he would be severely confused
[*] Fixed a bug, where the tutorial would not end if the day ended during a tutorial
[*] Arcade mode skips tutorials now
[*] More precise tutorial text
[*] Harold's subtitles are more legible
[*] Cable switching improved
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1 (V 1.01)
notes.content:
First hotfix to address some immediate issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed a gamebreaking bug, where you could not get out of a tutorial
[*] Fixed incorrect version number
[*] Added controls scheme to the pause menu, so you can see the controls if you forget them
[*] Fixed something secret
[*] A certain something (secret) was too pink
[/list]

notes.title: The game is released!
notes.content:
[h1][i]End Transmission?[/i] is finally out![/h1]

[i]End Transmission?[/i] is a game about the inevitable end and what you do with the time you have left. Play as Lenna, a teenager who couldn't take the silence anymore. Determined to share some of her optimism, Lenna broke into an old, abandoned radio tower, reigniting its transmitter. Now you must help her turn the silence into celebration by broadcasting music, taking calls, and boosting the morale of a weary world.

So get out there, put on your favourite tape, and broadcast one final transmission!

We hope you have as much fun playing the game as we had making it!

End Transmission? was made by Team Tall Trees, a group of 14 students over 2-4 months as part of the Danish games programme DADIU.
